evidence.method: static Objective-C method disassembly; values are native layer units, normally AppKit points

geometry.applicationIconImage: application icon supplied as NSImage, converted to CGImage; transparent padding belongs to input icon
geometry.coordinateNote: These formulas are native layer coordinates. In ordinary AppKit y-up coordinates, negative y moves downward. CSS y-down equivalent uses centerY + 18. Verify any flipped host before reuse.

badge.warning: Native NSColor inputs, not screenshot-sampled RGB or a promise of final display-space color

changes: white checkmark scale 0.01 to 1 with spring
badge position center to lower-right with spring
checkmark position center to lower-right with spring
checkmark color switches to calibrated black at alpha0.5

noApplicationIcon: showInSize skips the one-second app-icon stage and calls showFullCheckmark immediately. The mini-checkmark timer is scheduled only in the icon-present branch; no-icon path stays full-checkmark until stopped.
cancellation: stop increments transitionGeneration and removes animations; each scheduled callback checks captured generation before changing state
lifecycleNote: Computer Use native XPC presentations can retain the completion effect for30s. Browser Use screenshot presentations have a separate removal path that does not defer removal on completed state. Do not impose the30s hold on every browser screenshot.
